windows.description: Complete replacement of per-field lag windows; unlisted input fields use history=0 and horizon=0.

field.description: Exact observed technical name of an input field; duplicates and unknown names refuse before mutation.

history.description: Number of previous input rows copied for this field; zero adds no historical columns. Native upper bound awaits discovery.

horizon.description: Number of following input rows copied for this field; zero adds no future columns. Native upper bound awaits discovery.

incomplete_records.description: Explicit native incomplete-row policy: keep expanded edges, retain original rows only, or retain complete rows only. Exact NULL behavior awaits discovery; variable binding is unsupported.
